family: Gromark / lagged-recurrence keystreams (frontier item 4) -- INDEPENDENT ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION #2, reproduction lens
verdict: REFUTED (the hit is noise). The family's own Tier-2 negative for mod-10 digit primers at L=7/8 is UPHELD.

reproduction.independent_kernel: rv_kern.py (numpy, written from the model description; verified against 240 stored C-kernel cells, max |diff| 4.8e-7 = stored 6-dp precision)
reproduction.keystream_degeneracy_check: none - digit histogram flat (7..18 per digit over 144), no state repeat within 600 positions; unlike the earlier Hill gcd false lead this hit is not a degenerate vector, it is a genuine argmax
reproduction.roundtrip: VACUOUS, not passed. The model C=MIX(P)+k leaves MIX unconstrained (26! = 88 bits), so EVERY one of the 10^7 primers round-trips perfectly by construction. Round-trip exactness has zero discriminating power in this family; the only content is whether the residual is English, and it is not.

statistical.defect_in_the_claimed_z: gk_sweep.py computes z = (max over 10^7 primers - PER-PRIMER mean) / PER-PRIMER sd, taken from the kernel's mean/sd fields. Numerator is a maximum over 10 million draws, denominator the sd of a single draw. Verified arithmetically from the stored artifact: (0.063714-0.0396115)/0.0020115 = 11.98. Same failure mode as the Hill z=+5.78 and affine z=+4.91 false leads.
statistical.second_defect_in_the_pooled_ceiling: gk_analyze.py's pooled ceiling keys on (n, statistic, #primers) and so pools four recurrences and two text alphabets into one null. The 'fib' recurrence is structurally degenerate (null best-of-search 0.0495 vs 0.0575 for aca) and the A-Z reading of pk9 has a lower baseline IoC (per-primer mean 0.03855 vs 0.03961 for KA), so the pooled ceiling of 0.06284 is depressed relative to the aca/KA search that produced the hit. The ceiling the hit 'cleared' is not matched on either axis.

rebuilt_matched_null.seeds: 900000-900039 (verifier's own; independent of the claim's 1001/2002 and of the earlier verification's 770000-770019)
rebuilt_matched_null.identical_search: same full 10^7 primer enumeration, rec=aca, L=7, mod 10, KA text alphabet, sign -1, shift-IoC statistic, n=144, letter-shuffled pk9 (length and letter multiset preserved, so pk9's anomalous ct IoC .0445 is preserved)
rebuilt_matched_null.decisive: null draw seed 900039, a letter-shuffled pk9, scored 0.066822 under the identical search - BETTER than the real ciphertext's 0.063714

statistical.family_level_max_vs_max: at n=144, shift-IoC, full enumerations: real family of 32 cells max = 0.063714; the identical 32-cell family on shuffled copy 1001 max = 0.062840; on copy 2002 (16 cells) max = 0.060412

multiple_testing.family_level_check: 39 of 2032 real cells above their pooled matched-null max vs 35.62 expected (binomial sd 5.9 -> +0.57 sd). Both numbers recounted independently from the raw artifacts and reproduce exactly.

decrypt_autopsy.requirement: a correct primer leaves MIX(P), a monoalphabetic image of the (possibly transposed) plaintext

sorted_unigram_profile_chi2_transpositio.IoC_conditioned_null: against 3000 structureless random 26-letter count vectors of length 144 with IoC matched to 0.0637, the hit's profile chi2 of 0.0984 sits at the 73rd percentile - i.e. WORSE than the median structureless multiset at the same IoC. The English-looking profile is entirely bought by the maximised IoC and carries no extra evidence.

power_scale_check.note: the model admits no partial credit: a correct primer lands ~6x further out than this hit does

tier.family_negative: Tier 2 UPHELD for mod-10 digit primers at L=7 and L=8 under the four tested recurrences, both text alphabets, both directions, by exhaustion; the three corners the claim itself leaves open (26^7/26^8 letter primers unenumerated, mix-after-shift at n=144/153, transposition ON TOP of the Gromark) remain Tier 3
